title: fix(swf): encodePlaceObject3WithFilters drops colorEffect — add CXForm parameter
description:
When a display object has BOTH enabled filters AND a colorEffect, the SWF encoder loses the colorEffect. This is because encodePlaceObject3WithFilters (packages/swf/src/filters.ts) does not accept a CXForm parameter — HasColorTransform is hardcoded to 0 in its flags1 byte.

The bug affects:
- Symbol instances with filters + colorEffect (compile.ts line 2101, sprite.ts line 388)
- Bitmap display objects with filters + colorEffect (sprite.ts line 355)
- Text fields with filters + colorEffect (sprite.ts line 322)
- All of the above in posChanged/move branches (compile.ts line 2465, sprite.ts lines 427/437/468/489)

The fix is three-part:
1. Add optional cxform?: CXForm parameter to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters in filters.ts. Set HasColorTransform flag in flags1 when cxform is present. Emit encodeCXFormWithAlpha after MATRIX (matching the field order in encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode).
2. In compile.ts: pass instCXForm/cxformForFilters to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters at each filters-only call site. Also synthesize a zero-alpha CXForm from visible===false and from standalone alpha (like the blend-mode paths do).
3. In sprite.ts: similarly pass the computed CXForm to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters at each filters-only call site.

Acceptance: a unit test in packages/swf/src/__tests__/filterlist.test.ts (or a new filters-cxform.test.ts) compiles a symbol instance with a Glow filter (enabled) AND a tint colorEffect (e.g. type:'tint', tintAmount:50, tintColor:'#ff0000') and asserts the PlaceObject3 body has HasColorTransform set and correct CXFORMWITHALPHA bytes after the filter list.
